design: Tier 2: a cross-cutting change to every Claude agent run's argv, and a containment question. No migration and no UI. HAZARD: it reaches :8000's agents at :8000's next restart, and from then on a project's own .mcp.json servers and the operator's user-scope MCP servers no longer load in any Hub agent run. Nothing in spec/capabilities promises them (grep: the only match is agent-run-sandboxing's allowlist of the Hub's own server), and the Hub describes none of them to the agent, but an operator could have come to rely on one; the remedy is a runner flag --mcp-config naming it, which strict mode honours (criterion runner-flag). ROLLBACK: revert the one commit; no stored state changes. WHERE: _build_claude_command, not _claude_mcp_args, because the latter returns [] when no server is injected and that run must not inherit either. CLAUDE.md and project settings still load: the flag affects MCP servers only (measured for the titler, conversation_titles.py:81-83).

checked: _build_claude_command (runner_commands.py:172) is the only builder of a Claude agent turn's argv (build_command -> ClaudeAdapter -> _build_claude_command); inject_mcp returns _claude_mcp_args, the same fragment
ClaudeAdapter.one_shot already passes --strict-mcp-config for worker and title (claude.py:168-170)
F21 probe 2026-10-08: --strict-mcp-config leaves the Hub's 27 tools in system/init and removes the account connectors (alwaysLoad read-out); context unchanged at 26.5k without connectors loaded
Acceptance drive on today's :8010: 1/3; the argv lacks the flag and the agent named mcp__claude_ai_Claude_Docs__batch, create, delete, export, guide, query, read, update
limits: The drive's second check relies on the model reporting tool names it can see; the argv check is the deterministic half
Windows only: the drive reads the process command line through Win32_Process

problem: _build_claude_command (runner_commands.py:172) passes --mcp-config without --strict-mcp-config, so Claude Code merges in every server the operator's own configuration and account carry. Driven on :8010 on 2026-10-08 (scripts/drive/d1008_f531_no_connectors_drive.py, 1/3): a fresh Haiku agent's turn listed eight mcp__claude_ai_Claude_Docs__* tools; a Hub-shaped claude -p with alwaysLoad also showed Drive, Calendar and Gmail (needs-auth). Those tools were granted by no Hub surface, are described nowhere in the run's context, and under bypassPermissions or yolo are callable with no prompt. The Hub's one-shots (titles, workers) already pass the flag for this reason (claude.py:168-170; conversation_titles.py:81-83).

requirements.rationale: A run's tool surface is the Hub's to grant and describe; servers inherited from the operator's account or user configuration are neither granted nor recorded, and a no-server run must not inherit them either.
requirements.statement: Every Claude agent run the Hub spawns MUST load only the MCP servers named on its own command line, by passing --strict-mcp-config, whether or not the Hub's own server is injected.

requirements.rationale: The escape hatch for an operator whose agents need another server (a project's .mcp.json server, say): strict mode honours every --mcp-config on the command line.
requirements.statement: An MCP server a runner's flags name with --mcp-config MUST still load in that runner's runs.

in_scope: The argv of every Claude agent turn (_build_claude_command), with or without the Hub's MCP server injected
The agent-run-sandboxing capability: a requirement stating which MCP servers a Claude run loads
non_goals: Codex and Copilot runs: Copilot already runs in a Hub-made COPILOT_HOME; Codex reads ~/.codex/config.toml servers and is undrivable here (backlog, not this change)
A UI for choosing extra MCP servers per runner: runner flags already carry --mcp-config, which strict mode honours
The Hub's one-shot spawns: already strict

summary: Every Claude agent run the Hub spawns carries --strict-mcp-config, so it loads only the MCP servers the Hub's own --mcp-config names (the Hub's server, plus any a runner's flags add). The operator's claude.ai account connectors (Gmail, Drive, Calendar, Docs) and their user- and project-scope servers stop reaching agent runs (F531).
